Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 442)), although this passage is much longer and more detailed. The passage after the initial quotation (ending in Q7:138-139) may be from Ibn Kathīr and not Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-IHFXV02P081A-1]: The isnād drops from Jarīr b. Ḥāzim from the chains. Also notice that Q18:86 is misquoted here, it should read: &quot;حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِي عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًا ۗ قُلْنَا يَا ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّا أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّا أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا.&quot;
[^comment-RHWXV05P127A-1]: Passage not found in HSNX. Deals with the issue of the loss of a women&#x27;s hair and according to <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRQ" class="source-ref">HJRQV05P077A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghlīq al-taʿlīq ʿalā Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 5 p. 77), as witnessed by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), in the context of the revelation of Q24:31. <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRQ" class="source-ref">HJRQV05P077A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghlīq al-taʿlīq ʿalā Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 5 p. 77) appears to be the only Ibn Isḥāq passage that specifically discusses this verse. That it is found in Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī seems odd given the late date of the author. Similar passage also found in <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WYUAU.html" class="witness-link">WYUAU</a> (Yaʿlā b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Umayyah al-Īyādī al-Tanāfisī al-Kūfī) but do not refer to the same back story or refer to any Qurʾānic verse as a foundation. <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) gives the witness as ʿĀʾishah not Asmā bint Abī Bakr.
[^comment-SMJXV01P117A-1]: Passage not found in HSNX. The fragment discusses the rules of purity in facing the qiblah and an apparent contradiction in prohibitions. A similar passage with slightly different phrasing is also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Placement in fiqh section under prayer practices.
[^comment-MMUHV01P037B-1]: The isnād appears to drop Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd. and to refer to Abū Isḥāq instead of Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-TMKXV01P162A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-TMKX" class="source-ref">TMKXV01P162A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Tirmidhī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>ʿIlal al-Tirmidhī al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 162) سألت محمدا عن هذا الحديث فقال هذا حديث خطأ والصحيح عن الزهري عن الربيع بن سبرة عن أبيه ليس فيه عمر بن عبد العزيز وإنما أتى هذا الخطأ من جرير بن حازم.
[^comment-TMKXV01P246A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-TMKX" class="source-ref">TMKXV01P246A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Tirmidhī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>ʿIlal al-Tirmidhī al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 246) سألت محمدا عن هذا الحديث فقال هو عبيد بن فيروز ولا أعرف لعبيد حديثا مسندا غير هذا قال محمد وروى عثمان بن عمر عن الليث بن سعد عن سليمان بن عبد الرحمن عن القاسم أبي عبد الرحمن عن عبيد بن فيروز عن البراء وكان علي بن عبد الله يذهب إلى أن حديث عثمان بن عمر أصح قال محمد وما أرى هذا بشيء لأن عمرو بن الحارث ويزيد بن أبي حبيب رويا عن سليمان بن عبد الرحمن عن عبيد بن فيروز عن البراء قال محمد وهذا عندنا أصح.
[^comment-TBJXV22P453A-1]: Passage is not found in HSNX. Aws b. al-Ṣāmit is only mentioned once in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV1P693E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 693) in reference to his participation at Badr along with other members of the Anṣār. Similar passages are found under the witnesses of <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah), <a href="WMMAH.html" class="witness-link">WMMAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Maslamah al-Makhzūmī al-Madīnī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), <a href="WJHUN.html" class="witness-link">WJHUN</a> (Jaʿfar b. al-Ḥārith b. ʿUmārah al-Nikhaʿī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), and <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-IAAH" class="source-ref">IAAHV05P272A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAṭīyah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Muḥarrar al-wajīz fī tafsīr al-Kitāb al-ʿazīz</span>, vol. 5 p. 272) Q58 is a madīnan sūrah except for verse seven, which originates in the Meccan period and he goes on to say that the event occurred during the month of Ramaḍān, but does not specify a year. The passage describes Aws b. al-Ṣāmit as being in old age and somewhat enfeebled, since he is said to have participated in all of Muḥammad&#x27;s expeditions it must occur late, likely after the conquest of Mecca. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-AMHI" class="source-ref">AMHIV02P215A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Mālik b. Ḥusayn al-ʿIṣāmī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Samṭ al-nujūn al-ʿawālī fī anbāʾ al-awāʾil waʾl-tawālī</span>, vol. 2 p. 215) the event occured after Muḥammad returned from the conquest of Mecca. If it occured in Ramaḍān it must have occured prior to the Battle of Ḥunayn which took place in Shawwāl in the year 8. This would place it in relation to HSNX after <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P428A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 428) since Ibn Isḥāq states on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P437B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 437) that the conquest of Mecca occured on the 20th of Ramaḍān.
[^comment-BQSXV03P123A-1]: Passage not found in HSNX. The tradition is set during the ḥajj when ʿAdī b. ʿAdī al-Kindī advised Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Ṣāliḥ al-Makkī to go collect a tradition from Ṣafīyah bint Shaybah b. ʿUthmān b. Abī Ṭalḥah. Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Ṣāliḥ and ʿAdī b. ʿAdī al-Kindī are not mentioned in HSNX. Ṣafīyah bint Shaybah b. ʿUthmān is mentioned in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P411C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 411) regarding the Conquest of Mecca (also see via <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) <a href="../references.html#ref-NYMX" class="source-ref">NYMXV06P3378A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Nuʿaym</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span>, vol. 6 p. 3378)). Thawr b. Yazīd al-Kalāʿī, Abū Khālid, is mentioned three times by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P166A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 166), <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P308A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 308), and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P634C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 634)). According to Muḥammad b. Saʿd, he was from the people of Ḥimṣ and died in Jerusalem in 153/770 at the age of 60. His grandfather fought for Muʿāwiyah at Ṣiffīn against ʿAlī (<a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV07P324A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 7 p. 324)). Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Ṣāliḥ al-Makkī is mentioned in <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV01P171C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 1 p. 171), <a href="../references.html#ref-HJKX" class="source-ref">HJKXV01P583A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muslim b. al-Ḥajjāj</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Kunan waʾl-asmāʾ</span>, vol. 1 p. 583), <a href="../references.html#ref-BNTH" class="source-ref">BNTHV07P371C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Thiqāt</span>, vol. 7 p. 371), and <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV19P215A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 19 p. 215) only in relation to this tradition, although the latter source states that he also related from Mujāhid b. Jabr al-Makkī and in addition to Thawr b. Yazīd al-Ḥimṣī, he also related to Mujāhid b. Jabr al-Makkī. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRB" class="source-ref">HJRBV09P330A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-Tahdhīb</span>, vol. 9 p. 330) he lived in Jerusalem. No date of death is mentioned. ʿAdī b. ʿAdī b. ʿUmayrah al-Kindī al-Shaybānī, Abū Farwah al-Jazīrī, was a member of the al-Ḥārith b. Muʿāwiyah b. Thawr tribe. Described as pious by al-Ṭabarī, he commanded troops under Muḥammad b. Marwān against Khārijī rebels in 76/ 695 (<a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV06P243A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 6 p. 243)). He is described as a partisan of the Umayyads and was appointed as commander of Mūsil, the Jazīrah, and then Armīnīyah by ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz (<a href="../references.html#ref-TDSH" class="source-ref">TDSHV40P137A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAsākir</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh madīnat Dimashq</span>, vol. 40 p. 137), although <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV19P5354B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 19 p. 5354) states this was done by Sulaymān b. ʿAbd al-Mālik). He was included among the 3rd generation of successors in the Jazīrah and to have been trustworthy (ibid., 138). He died in 120/738 according to al-Dhahabī and others (<a href="../references.html#ref-DHBR" class="source-ref">DHBRV01P116D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿIbar fī khabar man ghabar</span>, vol. 1 p. 116)). Ṣafīyah bint Shaybah b. ʿUthmān b. Abī Ṭalḥah was a Meccan companion and related from many of the Prophet&#x27;s wives and related to many in the first generation of successors. No date of death is mentioned (see, <a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV35P212B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 35 p. 212)). One of the most comonly quoted traditions in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus. Passage also found in <a href="WAANH.html" class="witness-link">WAANH</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Numayr al-Hamdānī al-Khāraqī al-Kūfī), <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), and <a href="WASMR.html" class="witness-link">WASMR</a> (ʿAbd al-Raḥīm b. Sulaymān al-Marwazī al-Rāzī). Unable to place the date of the event in which the tradition was collected in Mecca. Most likely to be placed in the opinions of Muḥammad in fiqh section.
[^comment-RHWXV02P216A-1]: <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) includes a similar story in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P294D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 294) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P295A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 295) in the story of the Raid on the Banū al-Muṣṭaliq and the Prophet&#x27;s marriage to Jūwayrīyah bint al-Ḥārith in a narrative structure much like that found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WSSAA.html" class="witness-link">WSSAA</a> (Ṣadaqah b. Sābiq al-Muqʿad), <a href="WAMAQ.html" class="witness-link">WAMAQ</a> (ʿAlī b. Mushir al-Kūfī al-Qurashī), and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) also witnessed an account completely unlike his other version and unlike other versions. The story related by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) is narratively different. <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) produced a truncated version. <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah) relates the story with yet another narrative structure.
[^comment-BNHXV09P361B-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BNHX" class="source-ref">BNHXV09P361A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iḥsān fī taqrīb Ṣaḥīḥ Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, vol. 9 p. 361) and <a href="../references.html#ref-BNHX" class="source-ref">BNHXV09P361B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Iḥsān fī taqrīb Ṣaḥīḥ Ibn Ḥibbān</span>, vol. 9 p. 361) are an excellent example of fragmentation.
[^comment-STBXV01P308A-1]: This is similar to the passage on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P646C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 646) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P647A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 647). The passage following &quot;بالعدسة فقتله&quot; is not found in HSNX but a similar passage following the same structure as <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-ref">TKXXV03P054A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 54) is found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī) includes a brief entry, similar to <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTTH" class="source-ref">ZTTHV01P167A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr al-safar al-thālith</span>, vol. 1 p. 167)
[^comment-SFTXV01P054A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P494A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 494) and describes the prophet&#x27;s first week in Madīnah. <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P494B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 494) forms a/ pa/rt of this passage. The wording in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) is different from that found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. [^comment-BMMXV01P072A-1]: These specific passages are not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Placement based on content and the beginning of ritual practices, in this instance, treating the issue of ablutions for every prayer and its abrogation (approximate to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P584D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 584)). Of this tradition, Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā b. Sawrah al-Tirmidhī states: وقد روى هذا الحديث محمد بن إسحاق عن محمد بن إبراهيم عن أبي سلمة عن زيد بن خالد عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وحديث أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة وزيد بن خالد عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كلاهما عندي صحيح لأنه قد روي من غير وجه عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم هذا الحديث وحديث أبي هريرة إنما صح لأنه قد روي من غير وجه وأما محمد فزعم أن حديث أبي سلمة عن زيد بن خالد أصح وفي الباب عن أبي بكر الصديق وعلي وعائشة وابن عباس وحذيفة وزيد بن خالد وأنس وعبد الله بن عمرو وابن عمر وأم حبيبة وأبي أمامة وأبي أيوب وتمام بن عباس، وعبد الله بن حنظلة وأم سلمة وواثلة وأبي موسى (see <a href="../references.html#ref-TMSX" class="source-ref">TMSXV01P034B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Tirmidhī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-Tirmidhī</span>, vol. 1 p. 34)). This passage is one of the most frequently related traditions in the Ibn Isḥāq corpus with 88 witnessed variations across 13 witnesses. The largest collection of variations are in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV02P272A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. The tradition is related to Ibn Isḥāq from several different sources: Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥārith al-Taymī, Saʿīd b. Abī Saʿīd al-Maqrubī, Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā b. Hibbān (sometimes listed as Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā b. Hissān), Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Abī al-Rajāl al-Ṣalaḥī, and Ibn Isḥāq’s uncle, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Yasār.
[^comment-BQWXV07P260C-1]: There is a mistake in this <em>isnād</em> and the source name Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ḥusayn should be listed as Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ḥuṣayn. A similar story is found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHS" class="source-ref">KTHSV04P532C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrat al-nubuwīyah</span>, vol. 4 p. 532), and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV05P267D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 5 p. 267).
